Grafts · Fertility of Flesh · Mutation as Blessing

Born in a mass grave-turned-nursery, where enough desperate mothers and field-healers poured hope and blood-magic into keeping infants alive through the Long Fall that something coalesced and started listening back. She appears, if at all, as a shifting many-armed silhouette wrapped in half-formed newborn faces, none of them finished, none of them screaming.

She grants healers and grafters an uncanny surgical luck — the cut that shouldn't have worked, the transplant that takes on the first try.

UNLOCK — "Petition Mother Marrow" (6th level, requires a successful birth or a life saved against real odds) opens access to Mother Marrow's Gift at 18th level.
